answers.value: 2 only: the Speaker takes no separate oath on assuming office
answers.reasoning: The Speaker is elected by the Lok Sabha from among its members (Article 93), not by the Election Commission, so statement 1 is wrong. There is no separate oath for the office of Speaker beyond the member's oath, so statement 2 is correct. Under Article 100 the Speaker does exercise a casting vote in a tie, so statement 3 is wrong.
